excluded_domains.name: Capcom Pictures
excluded_domains.reason: Official Capcom group information identifies Capcom Pictures as a motion-picture planning and production-management subsidiary, not a game-development studio. The prior CAPCOM U.S.A. Jobvite route was not evidence of hiring for Capcom Pictures.

excluded_domains.name: Game Boost Sweden
